text:
ana: Heads-up: small but important compliance bulletin for Private 2.5 pilot customers. We're opening a 30-day audit evidence window and a coordinated penetration-test schedule. Read below and flag any blockers.

laura: Legal/compliance summary: we'll surface SOC 2 Type II artifacts and evidence packages to pilot customers who sign an NDA addendum. This is a controlled release; do not promise broad distribution.

sam: Security notes: coordinated pentest windows are voluntary but recommended. We'll provide a whitelist ip ranges and temporary elevated logging for the test. Reminder: in air-gapped installs, customers must run their own pentest tooling and share redacted reports.

jia: Ops plan: evidence window = 2026-05-04 to 2026-06-04. During that time we will: enable extended audit logs for pilot control planes, freeze config rollouts for pilot tenants, and provide per-tenant evidence export scripts. Runbook: /runbooks/private-2.5-audit-window.md

maria: CS/process: CSMs please collect signed NDA addenda before granting evidence packs. We'll offer a 30 minute hand-off call to walk customers through artifacts. I'll post a one-pager for CSMs in the pilot kit.

security-bot: "alert: temporary-evidence-access enabled for tenants in pilot group at 2026-04-15T09:00Z"

laura: Legal note: language for sales should read 'FedRAMP readiness artifacts available under NDA' not 'FedRAMP certified' or 'authorized'. I'll share approved phrasing in the sales playbook.

sam: On pentest scheduling: propose two windows per tenant (weekdays only) to reduce blast radius. We'll coordinate with customer security teams and the penetration-test vendor (approved partners list).

jia: Quick command to export audit package for a tenant (internal tool):

```bash
rwinf-export-audit --tenant-id T-12345 --since 2026-04-01 --output /tmp/T-12345-evidence.zip
```

ana (ops): Note: for on-prem appliance customers, evidence export is best-effort; some artifacts require agent-side collection. CS should verify agent version >= 2.5.1.

maria: We'll include a checklist for customers: signed NDA, scheduled handoff call, network allowance for vendor testing, agent >= 2.5.1.

laura: Action: I'll prepare the NDA addendum template and an FAQ about what the evidence pack contains. ETA: 2 business days.

sam: Also adding a short cryptographic summary to the pack (algorithms, key lengths, KMS options). Good to avoid surprises.

deploy-bot: "scheduled: private-2.5-audit-window start 2026-05-04T08:00Z"

ana (ops): EOL note: we'll extend legacy non-VPC support for customers in the audit window by 90 days to avoid disrupting active tests. Please communicate to impacted accounts.

ana: Thanks team. Pilot customers, if you want to participate in the evidence window but have timeline conflicts, DM me and we'll try to accommodate.

maria: Adding this to the pilot kickoff deck and CS playbook now.

ana: If you're reading and not part of the pilot, react :eyes: and we'll share the artifacts summary after the window closes.
